title: Content Marketing Tips for Small Businesses - Happy State Bank

facts.fact: The page states that content marketing may take 3-6 months of regular posting before a business begins to see any results.
facts.quote: It could take 3-6 months of regular posting before you begin to see any results.

facts.fact: The page presents nine tips for small business owners to make the most of content marketing.
facts.quote: Here are nine tips to help small business owners make the most of content marketing.

facts.fact: The page says that a content creation calendar gives deadlines and a schedule of content to be produced, and that content marketing is 'not all about selling.'
facts.quote: A content creation calendar will give you deadlines and a schedule of content that needs to be produced.
